identity.name: E1
identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

design_strategies.modal_philosophy: The 'Final Proofread' Protocol. Do not treat this as a system alert. Treat it as a physical letter review before dropping it in the mailbox.

visual_style.glassmorphism: Use heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl) for the overlay to silence the background noise.
visual_style.card_texture: Matte dark surface (#161b25) with a subtle 1px border (rgba(232, 98, 138, 0.2)).

typography_hierarchy.recipient: Large, distinctive. 'Sending to COACH NAME'. Verify identity.
typography_hierarchy.subject: Bold, clear. No truncation.
typography_hierarchy.body: Monospace or clean sans-serif (Inter/Jakarta) with generous line-height (1.6) for readability.

interaction_design.entrance: Scale up from 0.95 opacity 0 to 1 opacity 1 (spring physics).
interaction_design.hover_states: Buttons must physically lift (-translate-y-0.5) and glow.
interaction_design.send_action: The 'Commit' button. Gradient background (Pink to Red). 100% width on mobile.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent: Integrate this modal into the parent page (likely 'RecruitingBoard.js' or where the email send logic resides).
Ensure the modal intercepts the send action.
Use the 'ScrollArea' component for the email body if it is long.
Match the pink/red gradient from the sidebar for the primary action button.
